title: Hex
description: A community driven minecraft cosmetic project
body:
Hex

Create. Collect. Wear.

A community-driven Minecraft cosmetics platform.

Community · Catalog · API docs

--- ## About Hex is a community-driven cosmetics platform for Minecraft focused on high-quality capes and player customization. Browse community creations, collect your favorites, and wear them in-game through the Hex mod. ## Features - Community-created capes - In-game cape rendering - Online cape catalog - Discord account integration - Fast cape synchronization - Open catalog with public submissions - Lightweight client-side implementation ## Compatibility > ⚠️ Hex is not compatible with other cape mods. Running multiple cape providers at the same time may cause rendering issues or unexpected behavior. ## Installation 1. Download the latest release. 2. Install the required mod loader version. 3. Place the Hex mod into your `mods` folder. 4. Launch Minecraft. 5. visit [https://dash.hexcapes.qzz.io](https://dash.hexcapes.qzz.io) and follow the registration instructions ## Community Join the Hex community to submit capes, report issues, and stay updated with new releases. - Discord: https://dsc.gg/hexcapes - Catalog: https://dash.hexcapes.qzz.io
